quality.limitations: Same-symbol, stage and session observations are dependent. Wilson bounds are descriptive, not proof of a trading edge. Missing windows remain unscorable.
quality.recallDefinition: Top 50 positive session gainers detected before +10%; distinct from profitable trading.
